intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: TriageFlow is a demonstration portfolio project. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.

data.title: What Data We Collect
data.content: We collect three types of data: (1) Your email address, used for account registration and login. (2) Symptom descriptions — the text you enter during triage interviews. (3) Triage outcomes — AI-generated recommendations based on your symptoms.

openrouter.title: AI Processing (OpenRouter)
openrouter.content: Your symptom descriptions are sent to an AI model via OpenRouter to generate triage recommendations. No data is sold, shared with third parties, or used for marketing. The AI provider processes your symptom text solely for the purpose of generating the triage result.

email.title: Email Usage
email.content: Your email address is used exclusively for authentication — it identifies your account and enables login. We do not send marketing emails, newsletters, or unsolicited communications. Your email is never shared with third parties.

retention.title: Data Storage & Retention
retention.content: All data is stored in a PostgreSQL database. JWT authentication tokens are stored in your browser's localStorage. Language and theme preferences are also stored in localStorage. No tracking cookies, analytics, or third-party scripts are used. As this is a demo system, data may be reset at any time.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: As this is a demo system with no persistent production deployment, data may be reset at any time. You can delete your account and all associated data by contacting the developer. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data.

terms.title: Terms of Service

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: By using TriageFlow, you acknowledge and agree to the following terms. TriageFlow is a portfolio demonstration project and these terms define the scope of acceptable use.

demo.title: Demonstration System
demo.content: TriageFlow is a portfolio demonstration project, not a production medical service. All triage recommendations are generated by artificial intelligence for illustrative purposes only. The system is designed to showcase full-stack development proficiency, not to provide real medical services.

noMedical.title: Not Medical Advice
noMedical.content: The AI-generated triage recommendations are not real medical advice. They are synthetic demonstrations of what an AI triage pipeline could produce. Do not rely on them for actual medical decisions. If you have a medical concern, consult a qualified healthcare professional immediately.

noLiability.title: No Liability
noLiability.content: The developer assumes no liability for any actions taken based on the AI-generated content in this demo application. Use is entirely at your own risk. The developer makes no warranties regarding the accuracy, completeness, or fitness of the triage results for any purpose.

data.title: Data Handling
data.content: Data submitted to this demo may be processed by third-party AI providers (OpenRouter). No data is sold or used for purposes beyond the demo functionality. All data is stored in a secure PostgreSQL database. See our Privacy Policy for complete details on data collection and handling.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms. Users are encouraged to review this page periodically.

terms.contact: For questions about these terms, contact piotr@piotrswiderski.dev

cookies.title: Cookie Policy

localStorage.title: Local Storage Usage
localStorage.content: TriageFlow uses browser localStorage to store: (1) JWT authentication token — required to keep you logged in (essential). (2) Language preference — remembers whether you chose English or Polish (preference). (3) Theme preference — remembers whether you chose light or dark mode (preference). (4) Cookie consent acknowledgment — remembers that you've seen the consent notice.

sessionStorage.title: Session Storage Usage
sessionStorage.content: Admin impersonation state is temporarily stored in sessionStorage — it holds the admin's original token during user impersonation. This data is automatically cleared when the browser tab is closed. No other sessionStorage keys are used.

noTracking.title: No Tracking
noTracking.content: We do not use any analytics, tracking cookies, third-party scripts, or any form of user behavior tracking. This is a demo application — what you see is what you get. There are no hidden trackers, no fingerprinting, and no data collection beyond what is necessary for the application to function.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: The only third-party service involved in this application is OpenRouter, which processes symptom descriptions to generate AI triage recommendations. OpenRouter does not set cookies in your browser. No advertising networks, analytics providers, or social media platforms are integrated.

consent.title: Cookie Consent
consent.content: TriageFlow does not use traditional browser cookies. The consent banner is displayed for transparency about our localStorage and sessionStorage usage. By using the application after seeing the banner, you acknowledge this storage usage. You can clear all stored data at any time by clearing your browser's site data.

cookies.banner: TriageFlow doesn't use traditional browser cookies. We use localStorage for authentication tokens, language preferences, and theme settings. No analytics or tracking is used. By continuing, you acknowledge this storage usage.
